WITH current_user_connections AS (
            SELECT
                conn.organization_id,
                conn.provider,
                conn.crm_tenant_id,
                public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(conn.crm_user_id) AS canonical_crm_user_id
            FROM crm_connections conn
            WHERE conn.organization_id = $1
              AND conn.user_id = $2
              AND conn.status = 'CONNECTED'
              AND (
                    public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(conn.crm_user_id) IS NOT NULL
                    OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM crm_user_mappings mapping
                        WHERE mapping.organization_id = conn.organization_id
                          AND mapping.user_id = conn.user_id
                          AND mapping.provider = conn.provider
                          AND mapping.crm_tenant_id = conn.crm_tenant_id
                    )
              )
         ),
         current_user_canonical_owner_ids AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                current_conn.organization_id,
                current_conn.provider,
                current_conn.crm_tenant_id,
                current_conn.canonical_crm_user_id AS canonical_owner_id
            FROM current_user_connections current_conn
            WHERE current_conn.canonical_crm_user_id IS NOT NULL

            UNION

            SELECT DISTINCT
                mapping.organization_id,
                mapping.provider,
                mapping.crm_tenant_id,
                public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id)
                    AS canonical_owner_id
            FROM crm_user_mappings mapping
            INNER JOIN current_user_connections current_conn
               ON current_conn.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND current_conn.provider = mapping.provider
              AND current_conn.crm_tenant_id = mapping.crm_tenant_id
            INNER JOIN crm_principals principal
               ON principal.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND principal.id = mapping.crm_principal_id
            WHERE mapping.organization_id = $1
              AND mapping.user_id = $2
              AND principal.external_principal_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{15}([A-Za-z0-9]{3})?$'
              AND public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id) IS NOT NULL
         ),
         owned_principals_for_user AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                mapping.organization_id,
                mapping.provider,
                mapping.crm_tenant_id,
                mapping.crm_principal_id
            FROM crm_user_mappings mapping
            INNER JOIN current_user_connections current_conn
               ON current_conn.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND current_conn.provider = mapping.provider
              AND current_conn.crm_tenant_id = mapping.crm_tenant_id
            INNER JOIN crm_principals principal
               ON principal.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND principal.id = mapping.crm_principal_id
            WHERE mapping.organization_id = $1
              AND mapping.user_id = $2
              AND principal.external_principal_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{15}([A-Za-z0-9]{3})?$'
              AND public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id) IS NOT NULL

            UNION

            SELECT DISTINCT
                principal.organization_id,
                principal.provider,
                principal.crm_tenant_id,
                principal.id AS crm_principal_id
            FROM current_user_connections current_conn
            INNER JOIN crm_principals principal
               ON principal.organization_id = current_conn.organization_id
              AND principal.provider = current_conn.provider
              AND principal.crm_tenant_id = current_conn.crm_tenant_id
              AND (
                    principal.external_principal_id = current_conn.canonical_crm_user_id
                    OR (
                        principal.external_principal_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{15}([A-Za-z0-9]{3})?$'
                        AND public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id)
                            = current_conn.canonical_crm_user_id
                    )
              )
         ),
         ambiguous_raw_owner_ids AS (
            SELECT
                mapping.organization_id,
                mapping.provider,
                mapping.crm_tenant_id,
                public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id)
                    AS canonical_owner_id
            FROM crm_user_mappings mapping
            INNER JOIN current_user_connections current_conn
               ON current_conn.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND current_conn.provider = mapping.provider
              AND current_conn.crm_tenant_id = mapping.crm_tenant_id
            INNER JOIN crm_connections mapped_conn
               ON mapped_conn.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND mapped_conn.user_id = mapping.user_id
              AND mapped_conn.provider = mapping.provider
              AND mapped_conn.crm_tenant_id = mapping.crm_tenant_id
              AND mapped_conn.status = 'CONNECTED'
            INNER JOIN crm_principals principal
               ON principal.organization_id = mapping.organization_id
              AND principal.id = mapping.crm_principal_id
            WHERE mapping.organization_id = $1
              AND principal.external_principal_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{15}([A-Za-z0-9]{3})?$'
              AND public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id) IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY
                mapping.organization_id,
                mapping.provider,
                mapping.crm_tenant_id,
                public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(principal.external_principal_id)
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mapping.user_id) > 1
         ),
         candidate_account_sources AS (
            SELECT
                src.organization_id,
                src.account_id,
                src.provider,
                src.crm_tenant_id,
                assignment.id AS assignment_id,
                assignment.crm_principal_id AS assignment_crm_principal_id,
                raw.id AS raw_record_id,
                public.try_canonicalize_salesforce_id18(raw.payload ->> 'OwnerId')
                    AS raw_owner_canonical_id
            FROM account_sources src
            LEFT JOIN crm_account_assignments assignment
              ON assignment.organization_id = src.organization_id
             AND assignment.account_source_id = src.id
             AND assignment.role = 'PRIMARY_OWNER'
            LEFT JOIN crm_raw_records raw
              ON raw.organization_id = src.organization_id
             AND raw.id = src.latest_raw_record_id
            WHERE src.organization_id = $1
              AND (
                    src.latest_raw_record_id IS NULL
                    OR COALESCE(raw.source_deleted, false) = false
              )
         ),
         mine_account_ids AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                source.organization_id,
                source.account_id
            FROM candidate_account_sources source
            LEFT JOIN owned_principals_for_user owned_principal
              ON owned_principal.organization_id = source.organization_id
             AND owned_principal.provider = source.provider
             AND owned_principal.crm_tenant_id = source.crm_tenant_id
             AND owned_principal.crm_principal_id = source.assignment_crm_principal_id
            LEFT JOIN current_user_canonical_owner_ids owner_id
              ON owner_id.organization_id = source.organization_id
             AND owner_id.provider = source.provider
             AND owner_id.crm_tenant_id = source.crm_tenant_id
             AND owner_id.canonical_owner_id = source.raw_owner_canonical_id
            LEFT JOIN ambiguous_raw_owner_ids ambiguous_owner
              ON ambiguous_owner.organization_id = source.organization_id
             AND ambiguous_owner.provider = source.provider
             AND ambiguous_owner.crm_tenant_id = source.crm_tenant_id
             AND ambiguous_owner.canonical_owner_id = source.raw_owner_canonical_id
            WHERE (
                    source.assignment_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND owned_principal.crm_principal_id IS NOT NULL
                  )
               OR (
                    source.assignment_id IS NULL
                    AND source.raw_record_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND source.raw_owner_canonical_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND owner_id.canonical_owner_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND ambiguous_owner.canonical_owner_id IS NULL
               )
         )
         SELECT
            a.id AS "id!",
            a.name AS "name!",
            COALESCE(oa.status::text, a.status::text) AS status,
            COALESCE(oa.lifecycle_stage::text, a.lifecycle_stage::text) AS lifecycle_stage,
            COALESCE(
                a.industry,
                NULLIF(btrim(brief_narrative.content #>> '{info_grid,industry}'), '')
            ) AS industry,
            a.city,
            a.country,
            COALESCE(
                a.employee_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(replace(btrim(brief_narrative.content #>> '{info_grid,employees}'), ',', ''), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                     AND NULLIF(replace(btrim(brief_narrative.content #>> '{info_grid,employees}'), ',', ''), '')::numeric <= 2147483647::numeric THEN
                        NULLIF(replace(btrim(brief_narrative.content #>> '{info_grid,employees}'), ',', ''), '')::integer
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            ) AS "employee_count?: i32",
            a.logo_storage_key,
            a.website,
            COALESCE(latest_run.status::text, 'PENDING') AS "research_status!",
            latest_run.current_stage::text AS research_current_stage,
            CASE
                WHEN btrim(snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_score') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                 AND btrim(snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_score')::numeric BETWEEN -2147483648::numeric AND 2147483647::numeric THEN
                    ROUND(btrim(snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_score')::numeric)::integer
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "fit_score?: i32",
            CASE
                WHEN (
                    btrim(snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_score') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                    AND btrim(snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_score')::numeric BETWEEN -2147483648::numeric AND 2147483647::numeric
                ) THEN
                    NULLIF(
                        btrim(COALESCE(
                            snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_label',
                            snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fitLabel'
                        )),
                        ''
                    )
                ELSE
                    NULLIF(
                        btrim(COALESCE(
                            snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fit_label',
                            snapshot_narrative.content ->> 'fitLabel'
                        )),
                        ''
                    )
            END AS fit_label,
            (af.id IS NOT NULL) AS "is_favorited!",
            GREATEST(ora.updated_at, oa.updated_at, a.updated_at) AS "updated_at!"
         FROM organization_researched_accounts ora
         INNER JOIN organization_accounts oa
            ON oa.organization_id = ora.organization_id
           AND oa.account_id = ora.account_id
         INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.id = oa.account_id
         LEFT JOIN account_narratives brief_narrative
            ON brief_narrative.organization_id = ora.organization_id
           AND brief_narrative.account_id = ora.account_id
           AND brief_narrative.user_id IS NULL
           AND brief_narrative.variant = 'BRIEF'::account_narrative_variant
         LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT content
            FROM account_narratives
            WHERE organization_id = ora.organization_id
              AND account_id = ora.account_id
              AND user_id IS NULL
              AND variant = 'SNAPSHOT'::account_narrative_variant
            ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
            LIMIT 1
         ) snapshot_narrative ON TRUE
         LEFT JOIN account_favorites af
            ON af.organization_id = ora.organization_id
           AND af.account_id = ora.account_id
           AND af.user_id = $2
         LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT
                run.status,
                run.current_stage
            FROM account_research_pipeline_runs run
            WHERE run.researched_account_id = ora.id
            ORDER BY run.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
         ) latest_run ON TRUE
         WHERE ora.organization_id = $1
           AND ora.removed_at IS NULL
           AND (
                NOT $3
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM mine_account_ids mine
                    WHERE mine.organization_id = ora.organization_id
                      AND mine.account_id = ora.account_id
                )
           )
         ORDER BY lower(a.name) ASC, a.name ASC, a.id ASC
